objective: Close the remaining evidence-integrity gap where a Unity script/assembly reload could erase the in-memory facade-sill reflection epoch and allow a later fingerprint evaluation to arm a replacement sill root as if it were the original baseline state.
priorityRationale: The preceding sill-reflection run explicitly identified domain reload as its unresolved coherence risk. Because Visual Fidelity points for lighting/reflections/material response must come only from actual rendered evidence, the reflection request, poll, completion and pre-still checks must remain bound to the same persisted construction state even if Editor assemblies reload between those phases. Adding more decorative geometry before fixing this would increase implementation breadth while leaving the scoring evidence path weaker than the geometry it is intended to judge.

commitsBeforeRunRecord.message: qa: persist sill reflection epoch across assembly reloads

implementation.epochPersistence: Replaced process-local static epoch booleans/InstanceID storage with UnityEditor.SessionState keys. The armed/authored flags, benchmark scene GUID, generated-root GlobalObjectId and a non-empty epoch token now survive script/assembly reloads for the lifetime of the Editor session.
implementation.stableObjectIdentity: Generated fallback sill evidence is bound by UnityEditor.GlobalObjectId instead of GetInstanceID(). Post-arm validation recomputes the scene object's GlobalObjectId and fails closed if the root was deleted or replaced, even if Unity could recycle a process-local InstanceID.
implementation.sceneIdentity: The persisted benchmark scene GUID is frozen at arm time and revalidated on every reflection fingerprint evaluation.
implementation.unsavedObjectPolicy: A generated root that cannot provide a non-null stable GlobalObjectId is rejected for formal reflection evidence; an unsaved replacement may not inherit an earlier baseline.
implementation.resetPolicy: There is intentionally no scene-open or assembly-reload reset hook. SessionState clears when the Unity Editor process exits, making a clean Editor session the conservative fresh-epoch boundary rather than allowing evidence-time re-arming.

apiBasis.sessionState: Unity documents SessionState as Editor-session state that survives assembly reloading and is cleared when Unity exits.
apiBasis.globalObjectId: Unity 6 documents GlobalObjectId as a unique stable project-scoped identifier for scene/asset objects, persistent across scene save/reload and authoring serialization operations.
apiBasis.reasonForBoth: SessionState carries the epoch across managed-domain reloads; GlobalObjectId supplies stable scene-object identity where InstanceID is only process-local.

unresolvedRisks: Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime behavior is still unverified because this branch has no workflow run or commit-status context.
A real Editor must prove that SessionState values survive the exact script/assembly reload mechanism used by the capture environment and that the reflection fingerprint remains fail-closed afterward.
A real Editor must intentionally replace the generated sill root after arming and verify GlobalObjectId mismatch aborts evidence rather than repairing or re-arming it.

If the fallback sill root must be generated from a genuinely missing state, its persisted GlobalObjectId availability after formal preparation must be verified; formal evidence should fail rather than accept an unsaved unstable root.

This work does not determine whether the sill's dimensions, drain-opening scale, tray edge highlights or metal response look filmic; only actual native-4K frontal/oblique/grazing pixels can decide those questions.
It cannot clear visible_lod_pop or severe_aliasing_or_shimmer without the required temporal render sequence.
